name: assets_commission
description: GH #3891 / REQ-751 (assets C10), docs/assets/asset-workflow-documents.md sections 1 and 2. The header of an asset commission document (putting assets into the register). It is written only by module assets (managed type). document_id is the id of the versioned document of Letflow.Documents (decision 0056) that carries the state, the gap-free number and the issued time: no number, status or posted time is stored here (they are read from the versioned document and the posting mark). org_unit_id is the issuing org unit (queried; the scope column of decision 0076 R7). event_time is the time of the commissioning, ISO 8601 with offset, stored in UTC. location_id, material_responsible_id and actual_user_id are record ids of modules locations and org (other packs: no foreign key; the module checks them at issue). After issue nothing of the header changes.
